thread:
anika: FYI we started onboarding atelier17b (int6 hybrid) on staging and hit OOMs during long-session smoke—looks correlated with microbatch=2 + max_new_tokens=600. short sessions fine. anyone with ideas?

raj: saw identical failure on staging-04. stack: ```RuntimeError: CUDA OOM allocating 1.1 GiB (GPU 0; 48 GiB total, 44.3 GiB allocated)\n at runner/gen_loop.py:212```

mike: hypothesis: our int6 "chunked generation" path allocates an extra KV chunk for each microbatch, so transient peak ~microbatch * chunk_size. int6 also switched to larger activation scratch for the final attention matmuls.

daphne: quick experiments: 1) microbatch=1 -> OOM disappears 2) kernel_schedule=streamed_attn -> cuts peak by ~1.4GiB but +8ms p95 3) fp_prefix_layers=0-4 (first 5 layers fp16) -> long-context quality recovers, small perf hit.

anika: can we try combined: microbatch=1 + streamed_attn + max_new_tokens=384 and run the eval harness vs fp16 baseline?

infra-bot: deploy triggered: atelier17b-canary-6 -> staging-04 with config microbatch=1,max_new_tokens=384,kernel_schedule=streamed_attn,fp_prefix_layers=0-4

ci-bot: running automated smoke (200 requests) and bench scripts. ETA ~9m.

raj: note: lowering max_new_tokens globally hurts a few longform routes. recommend route-level override for /longform/* if we change default.

ci-bot: smoke complete. OOMs 0/200. latency p95 +6ms vs current int6 canary. quality (perplexity) on long prompts: fp16=19.4, int6-hybrid-default=21.0, int6-hybrid-with-fp-prefix=19.6.

mike: sounds like fp-prefix + streamed_attn is best compromise. next steps: 1) eng-runtime add auto-fallback for sessions where requested_max_tokens + context_length > 2500 to enforce microbatch=1+streamed_attn 2) eng-eval to run ngram and sampling bias checks before we flip model default 3) docs update with per-route overrides.

daphne: I'll start the sampling/regression job. leaving the canary running for 2h to capture sampled outputs.

anika: thanks. we'll reconvene after eval dump. :thumbsup:
